gloss: electric hot water dispenser; electric thermos pot

definitions.gloss: electric hot water dispenser; electric thermos pot
definitions.explanation: A countertop appliance that boils water and keeps it hot at a set temperature, dispensing it on demand with a pump or lever. A common fixture in Japanese homes and offices, used throughout the day for making tea, instant coffee, instant noodles, and baby formula.

notes:
Refers to the Japanese-style countertop dispenser that keeps water hot continuously, not the stovetop kettle sense of 'pot' in English. For the quick-boil electric kettle (the British-style appliance that shuts off after boiling), ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦ケトル→ケトル：05285_ketoru⟧ is the standard term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気|でんき}ポット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧: to boil water with an electric pot
- {電気|でんき}ポット⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to pour hot water from the electric pot
- {電気|でんき}ポット⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保温|ほおん}→保温：17467_hoon⟧: the warming/keep-warm function of the electric pot
- {電気|でんき}ポット⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put water into the electric pot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦ケトル→ケトル：05285_ketoru⟧: electric kettle — a faster-boiling, non-warming style of kettle; boils quickly and then shuts off
- やかん: stovetop kettle — a traditional metal kettle heated on a stove
- {湯沸|ゆわか}し{器|き}: water heater — a broader term, including instant water heaters
- ⟦{魔法瓶|まほうびん}→魔法瓶：17387_mahoubin⟧: thermos — a vacuum flask; keeps water hot without electricity

CULTURAL NOTE:
{電気|でんき}ポット is a classic Japanese appliance, particularly associated with homes with elderly family members, office break rooms, and households that make tea or instant coffee throughout the day. Many models offer 98℃, 90℃, and 70℃ keep-warm presets for different teas.
